spec.title: vscode PROP-008: Generators - the feature skeleton, the brand table, the nls.ts hook

status.comment: the type's answer to the generator templates; the anchored facts moved verbatim from modules/codkit/PROP-015 §5 in the split of 2026-09-09. The `gen` namespace, its flags, its exit codes and the licence header of the generated files stay in the engine

p.VSCODE-GENERATORS-ARE-TEMPLATES: What `codkit gen feature` and `codkit gen brand` write is a template of this type: a class in the shape of a Visual Studio Code contribution with dependency injection through the constructor, a test in the layout the upstream runners find, a brand table hooked into `_format` of `nls.ts`, and the `code-import-patterns` targets the hygiene of the distribution demands. The commands themselves, their flags, the `CK-E-GEN-EXISTS`/`CK-E-GEN-ID` refusals and the rule that the header of a generated file is the product's (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-015#GEN-HEADER-IS-THE-PRODUCTS`, `spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-015#GEN-REFUSES-EXISTING`) are the engine's; only the content of the templates comes from here.

p.GEN-FEATURE: `codkit gen feature <id> --title <text> [--setting] [--cold] [--holder <h>] [--license <spdx>] [--year <y>] [--header-style line|block] [--header-file <path>]`: the id has the form of `RT-DESCRIPTOR` (otherwise `CK-E-GEN-ID`, exit 2); the directory of the feature is the last segment of the id; it writes `delta/own/contrib/<name>/common/<name>.ts` (the id constants and, with `--setting`, the id of the setting), `delta/own/contrib/<name>/browser/<name>.contribution.ts` (a class `extends Disposable` with a DI constructor and a `registerFeature({...}, <Class>)` call; with `--cold`, `hotToggle: false`; the description of the setting through `localize`), `delta/own/contrib/<name>/test/browser/<name>.test.ts` (a skeleton with `ensureNoDisposablesAreLeakedInTestSuite`; the test lies in the directory of the feature - `GEN-TEST-LIVES-WITH-THE-FEATURE`); at the end it prints the import line for the composition root of the product and a reminder to declare the unit in `patchset.delta.json`.

p.GEN-TEST-LIVES-WITH-THE-FEATURE: The test of the skeleton lies inside the directory of the feature (`delta/own/contrib/<name>/test/browser/`) and not in a common `delta/own/test/`: a unit of the own manifest owns its own tests, and the declaration of the single unit `delta/own/contrib/<name>` covers both the code and the test; the runners of the fork find it by the glob `vs/<ownDirName>/**/test/browser/**` (PROP-010 `TESTS-LAYER-SPLIT`). The reminder at the end of the command names only that unit.

brand.title: 2. The brand table and the nls hook

p.GEN-BRAND: `codkit gen brand [--holder …] [--license …] [--year …] [--header-style line|block] [--header-file <path>]` (the header is as in `gen feature`, `GEN-HEADER-IS-THE-PRODUCTS`) writes `delta/own/common/brand.ts` - a starter table of rules with one example and a comment about the exceptions, exporting `brandMessage = createBrandTransform(RULES)` - and prints the text of the hook for `_format` in `nls.ts` with two reminders: the hook is a patch of the product of type `hook`; the target `src/vs/{monaco.d.ts,nls.ts}` in `code-import-patterns` must permit `vs/<ownDirName>/common/~`.

p.GEN-BUNDLE: **`codkit bundles add` writes two files of this family through the generator of the bundles layer** (`spec://codkit/modules/codkit/PROP-007#CMD-BUNDLES-ADD`): the overlay record `delta/overlays/product.json.bundle-<name>.overlay.json` with one `append` on `["builtInExtensions"]` whose value is `{name, version, sha256, repo: ""}` (`##VSCODE-BUNDLED-EXTENSION` of PROP-003), and the guard test `<ownRoot>/test/node/bundles/<name>.test.ts` - a `suite('<id>')` of the node layer, which the product tests of `ci --profile build` run - that reads `product.json` of the tree through `FileAccess.asFileUri('')` of `vs/base/common/network.js`, finds the entry by name and asserts its version and hash - for a unit built per target, the whole `platformSpecific` map of the record. The test is generated and says so in its header: `codkit bundles update` rewrites it with the record. The relative specifiers are counted from the materialized location of the own root (`##VSCODE-GENERATORS-ARE-TEMPLATES`), and the directory `test/node/bundles/` must be inside a unit of the own manifest, as every own test (`##GEN-TEST-LIVES-WITH-THE-FEATURE`).
